verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents cash forecasting from business drivers, answering "how long your cash lasts," and one-line scenarios (a hire wave, a slipped quarter, a downside case) that show what a decision does before you commit. The docs never explicitly say burn and runway are computed separately for each scenario, or that the zero-cash date can be compared across scenarios, so that link is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit per-scenario burn/runway calculation, a zero-cash-date comparison view across scenarios, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
